title: How do rock layers pile up?
question: Which layer of the strata is the oldest?
steps: Drag a bucket with your finger and let go over the water tank: it pours.
Watch where the first pour ends up in the tank's layers.
You can drag the shell into the tank too.
observe: Gravel, sand and mud poured into water sink and settle on top of what is already there. So the first pour becomes the bottom layer, and the lower a layer is, the older it is.

terms.name: Strata
terms.description: Striped layers of gravel, sand, mud and more that sank in water and piled up, one after another.

terms.name: Fossil
terms.description: The body or the trace of a living thing from long ago, buried while the layers piled up.

terms.name: Volcanic ash
terms.description: Grey dust blown out when a volcano erupts. When it piles up, it makes a grey layer.

law.equation: first layer laid down = bottom layer
law.title: The order of the strata
law.description: Strata pile up from the bottom. So the bottom layer was laid down longest ago, and the higher ones came later. Fossils and volcanic ash in the layers tell us what happened back then.

tip: Drag a bucket with one finger and let go over the tank: it pours. Let go anywhere else and it goes back. In the cliff mission, pour in the same order as the cliff's stripes.
tip_short: Drag a bucket into the tank

stages.text: Pour gravel, sand and mud into the tank in order and make striped layers!
stages.say: The gravel you pour first ends up at the bottom. The sand goes on top of it, and the mud on top of all.
stages.miss: Start with the gravel, in order!

stages.text: Put in the shell so the fossil ends up in the middle layer!
stages.say: A living thing buried while the layers pile up becomes a **fossil**. A layer with fossils tells us what lived back then.
stages.miss: Put the shell in after the gravel!

stages.text: Pile gravel, sand, grey ash and mud in order, just like the cliff!
stages.say: The grey layer is ash that flew out when a volcano erupted long ago. It is called **volcanic ash**. Layers under the ash were laid down before the volcano erupted.
stages.win: The piece! A volcano erupted long ago?
stages.miss: Look at the cliff's stripes and pour in order!
